messages:
ana: Heads-up — onboarding LyraX-8B (Mistral-ish) int4 is hitting a deterministic loop on long summaries (~2k+ tokens).

sam: Repro so infra can run it?

ana: Command: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization`. loop starts ~token 2130 repeating short phrase. fp16 clean.

carla: Any conversion warnings in logs?

ana: Conversion log: `WARN rotary_scale 1.0->0.9 for head-group 5`; also kvcache printed `head_offset +1` for some shards.

dmitri: Sounds like headmap/proj-order or rotary mapping after conversion. Try forcing a head swap in runtime (swap 3 and 7) to test.

ana: Ran swap locally: loop reduced but ROUGE-L dropped ~0.7 vs fp16. Also ran tokenizer diff: ~23 token-split mismatches (ZWJ, composed vs decomposed accents).

sam: Two-pronged mitigation: short-term fallback to int8 for long requests; long-term: fix convert headmap + add NFKC tokenizer normalizer.

ana: Implemented runtime flag `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` to auto-fallback to int8 for requests >1500 tokens. Opened PRs: convert mapping + tokenizer-normalizer + runtime flag.

node-bot: Eval queued #6742 (fp16 / int4 raw / int4+swap / int4+tokfix / int4+fallback) — ETA 10m.

node-bot: Eval 6742 complete: ROUGE-L fp16=42.2; int4(raw)=38.4; int4+swap=40.2; int4+tokfix=41.7; int4+fallback=41.9.

carla: Fallback gives best quality for now. Latency/cost when fallback triggers?

ana: p50 +8ms, p99 +120ms on ~2k-token runs; cost delta ~+18% for those requests.

dmitri: Plan: merge convert + tokenizer fixes, enable feature-flag `lyrax-int4-fallback` in staging, run 72h smoke, promote to canary if stable. If tokenfix stabilizes int4, remove fallback. Add sliding-window perplexity to onboarding harness.

sam: Add regression test `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and a CI check for headmap roundtrip.

ana: Done — PRs linked in issue tracker. Repro curl for ops: `curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`.

carla: Thanks — please update canary dashboard when flag toggled and notify eng-sre if error-rate >2x baseline.

dmitri: I'll add the sliding-window perplexity job to the onboarding CI.
